claim: exercisedb.dev now presents itself as AscendAPI, previously ExerciseDB.
AscendAPI's documentation names github.com/ExerciseDB/exercisedb-api as its GitHub.
The free V1 tier is 1,500 exercises with 180p GIFs and needs no authentication.
quote: 1,500 exercises with 180p GIFs. No authentication required, just call the hosted API directly.

claim: The free V1 endpoint is oss.exercisedb.dev/api/v1/exercises.
AscendAPI describes the whole V1 dataset as over 2,000 exercises, available as a free hosted tier and a paid RapidAPI tier.
quote: featuring over 2,000 structured exercises with rich metadata, images, and GIFs. Available as a free hosted tier and a paid RapidAPI tier with enhanced features.

claim: Free V1 media is 180p GIFs only; 360p to 1080p images and GIFs are on the paid RapidAPI tier.
quote: The free tier includes 180p GIFs only . Multi-resolution images and GIFs (360p–1080p) are available on the paid RapidAPI tier .

claim: AscendAPI describes ExerciseDB V2 as 11,000+ exercises, 15,000+ videos and 20,000+ images.
quote: A multipurpose exercise dataset with 11,000+ exercises, 15,000+ videos, and 20,000+ images

claim: ExerciseDB V2 gives each exercise an MP4 demonstration video.
quote: Each exercise includes an MP4 demonstration video for in-app playback.

claim: Both V2 tiers are accessed via RapidAPI, and free-tier media is watermarked.
quote: Both free and paid tiers are accessed via RapidAPI. The only difference is that free tier media is watermarked .

claim: The free Basic plan includes 2,000 requests a month.
The free Basic plan includes 200 exercises in the library.
AscendAPI's free plans are limited to 1,000 requests per hour per API key.
quote: All free plans include a limit of 1,000 requests per hour per API key.

claim: AscendAPI's paid plans have no strict rate limit.
quote: Paid plans have no strict rate limit.

claim: The exercisedb-api repository carries an AGPL-3.0 LICENSE file (a git clone on 2026-10-22 showed only README.md and LICENSE, last commit 2025-11-25).
The README links separate terms of use, which we could not open.
wger's application code is AGPL-3.0-or-later.
wger's exercise and ingredient data is Creative Commons, per entry.
quote: Exercise/Ingredient Data: Creative Commons (see individual entries)

claim: wger's README lists a REST API for third-party integrations or automations.
quote: REST API for third-party integrations or automations.

claim: Self-hosting wger is a docker compose up away, per its README.
quote: Hosting your own instance is basically just a `docker compose up -d` away.

claim: wger's nutrition uses Open Food Facts.
wger's README describes it as a free workout and fitness manager.
quote: wger (ˈvɛɡɐ) is a free workout and fitness manager.

Exercise images inherit the shared license model.
